approval_evidence.quote: On November 2, 2018, the Food and Drug Administration granted accelerated approval to lorlatinib (LORBRENA, Pfizer, Inc.) for patients with anaplastic lymphoma kinase (ALK)-positive metastatic non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC)

series_start_reason: Pfizer did not print Lorbrena as its own line in any release or 10-Q/10-K before the third-quarter 2020 release (checked every release 2018Q4-2020Q2 and the 10-Qs/10-Ks 2018-2021). The third-quarter 2020 release prints 2019Q3 (32) and nine months 2019 (77) in its prior-year columns, later releases give 2019Q4, 2020Q1, 2020Q2 the same way. 2019Q1 and 2019Q2 cannot be separated (the two together are 77-32 = 45 per the same release), so the contiguous citable series starts 2019Q3 although the product launched after the November 2018 approval.
search_log: listed PFE (CIK 0000078003) 8-K, 8-K/A, 10-Q, 10-K via data.sec.gov submissions (recent + older pages): 6671 filings; selected 8-Ks with Item 2.02 filed 2015-01 to 2026-08 (53, of which 48 carry an EX-99.1 earnings release; 2022-04-20, 2023-10-13 and 2023-12-14 filings are not quarterly earnings releases; the 2016-02-16 8-K/A carries no usable product table and the original 2016-02-02 release was used)

parsed every release's product tables with scripts/extract.py; quarter row = first occurrence of the product row, year-to-date row = third occurrence (or second where sub-region tables are absent); checked by summing quarters to the printed twelve-month figure
